products.name: GHK-Cu – Topical Cosmetic (1g)
products.shortDescription: GHK-Cu – Topical Cosmetic (1g) is a high-purity copper peptide used in cosmetic formulations for its ability to promote skin regeneration, reduce signs of aging, and support hair growth and wound healing.
products.description:
GHK-Cu (Glycyl-L-Histidyl-L-Lysine-Cu²⁺) is a naturally occurring copper-binding tripeptide renowned in cosmetic science for its powerful skin rejuvenating and tissue-repairing properties. As a key component in many anti-aging and hair restoration products, GHK-Cu has been shown in research to stimulate collagen and elastin production, improve skin texture and tone, reduce wrinkles, and promote healing.

It is also widely studied for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to protect the skin from environmental stressors and support a youthful appearance. Additionally, GHK-Cu may help strengthen hair follicles and encourage hair regrowth, making it ideal for use in hair serums and scalp treatments.

This 1g topical-grade peptide is ideal for cosmetic formulation and research, particularly in the development of anti-aging creams, serums, scar treatments, and hair care products.

Potential Cosmetic Applications:

Skin Rejuvenation – Boosts collagen and elastin, smooths fine lines

Wound Healing – Accelerates skin regeneration and repair

Hair Growth Support – Promotes stronger, healthier hair follicles

 Anti-Inflammatory & Antioxidant Effects – Protects and calms skin

Skin Firmness & Elasticity – Improves overall skin structure

This product is intended for TOPICAL cosmetic formulation only!

products.name: Glutanex Night Serum (30mL)
products.shortDescription: Glutanex Night Serum nourishes and repairs your skin while you sleep. Glutathione, Collagen, Peptides, and Vitamins work overnight to brighten skin tone, reduce dark spots, and restore deep hydration — so you wake up glowing every morning.
products.description:
Glutanex Night Serum is a pro-grade overnight skin care serum made to repair and renew your skin while you sleep. It works with your skin’s natural recovery cycle. Thanks to a powerful blend of Glutathione, Collagen, Peptides, and Vitamins, it deeply nourishes the skin through the night. As a result, you wake up to skin that looks brighter, feels smoother, and glows from within.

Why Choose Glutanex Night Serum?

This serum is more than just a night cream. In fact, it is a targeted overnight treatment for those who want real, visible results by morning. Here is what makes it stand out:

Overnight Brightening: First and foremost, Glutathione suppresses melanin while you sleep. This helps even out skin tone and reduce the look of dark spots over time.

Deep Hydration: In addition, Hyaluronic Acid, Collagen, and Beta Glucan work together overnight. They restore moisture balance and keep skin soft and plump by morning.

Anti-Aging Support: Furthermore, Peptides signal the skin to produce more collagen and elastin. This helps reduce fine lines and firms the skin with regular use.

Skin Repair & Renewal: It also helps repair damaged skin cells overnight. This makes it ideal for dull, dry, or tired-looking skin.

Temperature-Activated Formula: Finally, this serum is best kept cool before use. The temperature-activated formula boosts its soothing and hydrating effects on the skin.

Key Ingredients & What They Do

The results of the Glutanex Night Serum come from its rich mix of overnight repair ingredients. Specifically, here is what each one does:

Glutathione: Brightens skin tone and reduces dark spots. It also protects against oxidative stress caused by daily environmental damage.

Collagen (Fish/Marine): Improves skin elasticity and firmness. It helps reduce the look of wrinkles and sagging with regular use.

Peptides: Short chains of amino acids that boost collagen production. They firm the skin and support a stronger skin barrier.

Niacinamide: Reduces breakouts and helps fade post-inflammatory marks. It also helps even out skin tone for a clearer complexion.

Hyaluronic Acid & Beta Glucan: Lock in deep moisture overnight. They keep skin hydrated, smooth, and balanced by morning.

Vitamins: Nourish and protect the skin from within. They promote a healthier, more radiant complexion over time.

How to Use Glutanex Night Serum

For best results, simply follow these easy steps:

Cleanse your face well before bed.

Tone your skin to prep it for better absorption.

Apply a small amount of the Night Serum to your face. Use gentle upward strokes.

Massage lightly until fully absorbed into the skin.

Follow up with your night cream or moisturizer to seal in the benefits.

Pro Tip: Keep the serum refrigerated before use. The cool temperature boosts its soothing and hydrating effects.

products.name: Glutanex Snow White Cream (50mL)
products.shortDescription: Glutanex Snow White Cream delivers instant skin brightening with a powerful trio of Glutathione, Thioctic Acid, and Vitamin C. This non-sticky, tone-up day cream suppresses melanin, reduces dark spots, and leaves skin looking radiant and evenly toned from the very first use.
products.description:
Glutanex Snow White Cream is a pro-grade, whitening tone-up face cream made to brighten skin fast. It works from the very first use. Thanks to three powerful antioxidants — Glutathione, Thioctic Acid, and Vitamin C — it suppresses melanin and delivers an instant glow. As a result, skin looks brighter, feels lighter, and stays hydrated all day without any sticky residue.

Why Choose Glutanex Snow White Cream?

This cream is more than just a day moisturizer. In fact, it is a targeted brightening treatment for those who want a clearer, more even skin tone. Here is what makes it stand out:

Instant Brightening Effect: First and foremost, the triple antioxidant formula works fast. It delivers a visible tone-up from the very first application.

Melanin Suppression: In addition, Glutathione and Vitamin C block melanin production. This helps reduce dark spots, pigmentation, and uneven skin tone over time.

Anti-Aging Benefits: Furthermore, Thioctic Acid helps keep skin cells young. It also helps reduce the look of fine lines and wrinkles with regular use.

Non-Sticky Formula: It also absorbs cleanly into the skin. It provides light, comfortable hydration — ideal for all climates and skin types.

Pigmentation Prevention: Finally, this cream helps treat existing dark spots. It also helps stop new pigmentation from forming, especially after skin treatments.

Key Ingredients & What They Do

The results of the Glutanex Snow White Cream come from its triple antioxidant formula. Specifically, here is what each one does:

Glutathione: Suppresses melanin to brighten and even out skin tone. It also reduces dark spots and protects against daily environmental damage.

Thioctic Acid (Alpha Lipoic Acid): A strong antioxidant that fights free radicals. It also boosts Glutathione’s activity in the skin for stronger brightening results.

Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C): Protects against environmental damage and sun exposure. It also inhibits melanin production and supports the skin’s natural collagen levels.

Niacinamide: Reduces redness and refines pores. It also helps improve skin tone and supports a stronger, healthier skin barrier.

Arbutin: A gentle brightening agent that targets dark spots and hyperpigmentation. It is ideal for daily use without causing skin irritation.

For best results, simply follow these easy steps:

Cleanse your face well to remove all dirt and impurities.

Tone your skin to prep it for better absorption.

Apply a small, dime-sized amount of the Snow White Cream to your face.

Spread evenly using gentle upward strokes until fully absorbed.

Follow up with SPF in the morning to protect your results from sun damage.

Pro Tip: Keep the cream cool before use for a more soothing and refreshing application. On deeper skin tones, apply SPF or a BB cream on top to avoid any chalky finish.

products.name: Plenaris Exosome HGF
products.shortDescription: Plenaris Exosome HGF is a next-generation hair regeneration treatment combining Umbilical Cord-derived MSC Exosomes, Hair Growth Factors, Plant Stem Cells, and Peptides. It awakens dormant follicles, improves scalp microcirculation, and promotes thicker, healthier hair growth — developed through Root Cause Analysis to target the underlying causes of hair loss.
products.description:
Plenaris Exosome HGF is a pro-grade, next-generation hair regeneration treatment made to combat hair thinning and stimulate real hair growth. It works at the root. Thanks to a powerful blend of Umbilical Cord-derived MSC Exosomes, Hair Growth Factors, Peptides, Plant Stem Cells, and a Cell Nutrient Complex, it delivers bioactive molecules directly to the hair follicle and scalp tissue. As a result, dormant follicles are reawakened, scalp health improves, and hair grows back thicker, stronger, and healthier — naturally.

Why Choose Plenaris Exosome HGF?

This treatment is more than just a hair loss solution. In fact, it is a complete scalp regeneration therapy developed through advanced regenerative medicine research. Here is what makes it stand out:

MSC Exosome Technology: First and foremost, exosomes derived from Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stromal Cells are used. These nano-sized vesicles carry peptides, microRNAs, and signaling molecules that penetrate deep into the scalp to stimulate cellular repair and renewal.

Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Approach: In addition, Plenaris Exosome HGF is uniquely developed based on Root Cause Analysis. It targets the underlying causes of hair loss — including follicle aging, inflammation, and poor cellular activity — not just the symptoms.

Hair Growth Factor (HGF): Furthermore, Hair Growth Factors stimulate hair follicle cell regeneration and support the natural hair growth cycle. This helps transition follicles from the resting phase back into the active growth phase.

Scalp Revitalization & Microcirculation: It also nourishes hair follicles and improves blood microcirculation in the scalp. This creates a healthier environment for consistent, sustained hair growth over time.

Plant Stem Cells & Cell Nutrient Complex: Finally, plant stem cells and a targeted nutrient complex support and amplify the effects of the exosomes. They help strengthen follicles, reduce scalp inflammation, and improve overall hair density and vitality.

Key Ingredients & What They Do

The results of Plenaris Exosome HGF come from its advanced regenerative formula. Specifically, here is what each component does:

MSC-CM Exosomes (Umbilical Cord-Derived): Nano-sized vesicles rich in peptides, microRNAs, and growth signaling molecules. They improve intercellular communication, combat scalp inflammation, regenerate hair follicle cells, and create the ideal biological environment for new hair growth.

Hair Growth Factor (HGF): Stimulates hair follicle activity and promotes the natural anagen (growth) phase of the hair cycle. It helps reactivate dormant follicles for visibly thicker and denser hair.

Plant Stem Cells: Protect follicle stem cells from oxidative stress and aging. They support long-term follicle vitality and help maintain results between treatment sessions.

Peptides: Support scalp tissue repair and strengthen hair follicle structure. They also reduce inflammation and improve the overall health of the scalp environment.

Cell Nutrient Complex: Delivers essential vitamins and nutrients directly to the scalp and follicles. This fuels cellular energy and supports sustained hair growth activity over time.

What Hair & Scalp Concerns Does It Address?

Plenaris Exosome HGF is suited for a wide range of hair loss and scalp health concerns. Specifically, it is ideal for treating:

Male and female pattern hair loss (androgenetic alopecia)

Hair thinning and reduced hair density

Dormant or weakened hair follicles

Post-partum hair loss

Stress-related or diffuse hair shedding

Poor scalp health and microcirculation

How to Use Plenaris Exosome HGF

For best results, simply follow these easy steps:

Mix Formula 1 (Powder) and Formula 2 (Solvent) together before use.

Cleanse the scalp well to remove product buildup and prepare for absorption.

Administer via scalp injection or topical application — depending on the protocol recommended by your practitioner.

Massage gently into the scalp after application to encourage absorption and stimulate circulation.

Repeat every 3 weeks for initial sessions. Maintain results with sessions every 3 to 4 months.

Pro Tip: For maximum absorption, combine Plenaris Exosome HGF with a microneedling or derma roller session on the scalp. The micro-channels created allow the exosomes and growth factors to penetrate more deeply for stronger, faster hair growth results.

products.name: Plenaris Pro 80 (1 x 2.5mL)

Plenaris Pro 80 is a pro-grade, pure hyaluronic acid skin booster made to deeply hydrate, firm, and revitalise the skin. It works differently from standard HA products. Thanks to a high concentration of 80mg of stabilized Dual Molecular Weight Hyaluronic Acid per 2.5ml — produced through a unique thermal-to-cooling manufacturing process — it integrates naturally into the skin without swelling. As a result, skin looks firmer, feels deeply hydrated, and glows with renewed elasticity — with results lasting up to 6 to 9 months.

Why Choose Plenaris Pro 80?

This skin booster is more than just a hydration treatment. In fact, it is a complete bio-stimulation solution made for those who want real, long-lasting skin quality improvement. Here is what makes it stand out:

High-Dose 80mg Dual HA Formula: First and foremost, Plenaris Pro 80 contains 80mg of Hyaluronic Acid per 2.5ml — combining 40mg of High Molecular Weight HA and 40mg of Low Molecular Weight HA. This gives the formula a dual-action effect that works at multiple skin depths at the same time.

Unique Thermal-to-Cooling Manufacturing Process: In addition, the HA is produced using an innovative thermal-to-cooling stabilization method. This protects the structure of the HA molecules, preserving their performance, durability, and effectiveness without the need for chemical modification.

BDDE-Free & Biologically Fermented: Furthermore, the formula is completely free from BDDE cross-linking agents. It is made through a pure biological fermentation process, ensuring excellent skin compatibility and a very low risk of adverse reactions.

Sustained Collagen & Elastin Stimulation: It also provides a slow and sustained release of natural HA. This promotes increased elastin and collagen expression over time for firmer, smoother, and more resilient skin.

Natural Integration — No Swelling: Finally, when injected correctly into the malar-submalar area, Plenaris Pro 80 integrates naturally with no swelling. Results look smooth, balanced, and completely natural from the very first session.

Key Ingredient & What It Does

The results of Plenaris Pro 80 come from a single, highly refined active ingredient. Specifically, here is how it works:

High Molecular Weight HA — H-HA (40mg): Works at the surface and mid-dermis level to provide structural support and long-lasting volumisation. Its strong viscoelasticity helps lift and support the treated area for a natural, plump appearance.

Low Molecular Weight HA — L-HA (40mg): Penetrates deeper into the skin for immediate, widespread hydration and enhanced distribution. It ensures active ingredients are evenly delivered throughout the dermis for balanced, consistent results.

What Skin Concerns Does It Address?

Plenaris Pro 80 is suited for a wide range of hydration and anti-aging concerns. Specifically, it is ideal for treating:

Dry, dull, or dehydrated skin

Fine lines and early signs of aging

Loss of skin firmness and elasticity

Uneven skin texture and tone

Skin laxity on the face, neck, and hands

Overall skin quality improvement and bio-stimulation

Pro Tip: Avoid saunas, steam baths, and strenuous exercise for at least 48 hours after treatment. These can cause temporary redness or swelling at the injection sites and may affect the natural integration of the HA.

products.name: Tesoro Collagen (1 x 2.5mL)

Furthermore, the addition of Niacinamide helps to brighten the complexion and even out skin tone. As a result, users experience a comprehensive improvement in texture, moisture levels, and radiance.

This booster is suitable for addressing various signs of aging across the face and body. It is particularly effective for treating fine lines, acne scars, and loose skin. Key Benefits:

Structural Repair: Rebuilds the dermal layer for improved density.

Safety: Non-animal origin ensures high biocompatibility.

Hydration: Hyaluronic Acid locks in moisture for a plump look.

Brightening: Niacinamide reduces dullness and uneven tone.

Elasticity: Restores bounce and firmness to aging skin.
